identity_evidence: Live Purdue GIS attributes identify Delta Gamma, address 303 Waldron St, chapter abbreviation SODG, FID 783.
Official Purdue Beta Iota chapter page search-indexed text gives 303 Waldron and a front porch.
Indiana State Budget Committee April 2026 minutes describe the current 303 Waldron property as nearly 18,000 gross square feet, two stories and a basement.

The official Delta Gamma history is indexed as describing a Georgian U-shaped 1959 house, but direct retrieval failed and this does not match the simplified GIS ring conclusively. This conflict remains unresolved.
geometry_edits: Replaced eight-vertex rectangular legacy shell with the complete 14-vertex official feature footprint.
Added two-story illustrative facade, repeated windows, a front porch, and a shallow gable roof aligned to the longer footprint axis.
Added schematic upper-level lounge, bedroom and bunk-room inserts, informed only by a dated 2018 member blog.

interpretation_and_uncertainty.stories: Two modeled above-grade floors follow the more recent state budget committee description; Purdue GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 and CountOfFLO=1 conflict. Basement is not modeled above grade.
interpretation_and_uncertainty.height: Estimated: eave 7.2 m, ridge 10.3 m. No measured elevation is available.
interpretation_and_uncertainty.roof: Estimated shallow gable; no attributed roof-plan/elevation evidence.
interpretation_and_uncertainty.facade_and_materials: Brick-colored walls, light stone trim, blue glazing, and slate-colored roof are interpretive. Window count, rhythm, dimensions, and exact entrance location are estimates.
interpretation_and_uncertainty.interior: The room inserts are schematic, based on dated anecdotal description, and are not a current or measured floor plan.
interpretation_and_uncertainty.historical_plan_conflict: Chapter history's indexed Georgian U-shaped description is not established by the FID polygon. Current geometry is intentionally kept to the official source polygon; no unsupported courtyard wings were invented.
